items.title: 68642_Jo Jones oral history interview
items.q: He was with Collier's Shows and it was impossible, see, 'cause he had people like Johnny Hudgins on that show.

ctx.x: Who was he with, Jo, Mancy Campbell?

He was with Collier's Shows and it was impossible, see, 'cause he had people like Johnny Hudgins on that show. You couldn't get on that show. That was the greatest show and they never came up North. That was Collier and his two daughters. a different thing... ^ It was only in later years that they extended up through Canada, but I mean Mr. Collier had died, you see, and all those peoples, all those big peoples in there - Willie Too Sweet and all those peoples - and Johnny Knox who was one of the greatest…
When did you begin to get with dance bands and bands other than out of the circus?... Were there any bands that you begin to now get into like dance bands or what we consider orchestras now?
